title: StockSmart Field Service Booking Reference — Opening Consigned Stock in a New Consigned Bin
content:
## StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program: opening stock of a new consigned bin

**Rule.** Corbett books the opening consigned stock of a new consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines under the StockSmart opening consignment schedule, as one consigned-stocking line at the program's service visit of that day, at the item's contract unit price. A new consigned bin of this kind takes effect at the program's service visit of the day its entries stand, and its opening stock is placed at that visit; every other bin change still takes effect from the next visit or scan.

**Conditions of the bin's entries.**

1. The opening stock of such a bin is worked out only after its new-bin entry, flagged consigned and carrying its fill-to level, stands in the program's bin history.
2. The opening stock is not placed until the bin's par level entries carry a reorder point above zero.

Read against the bin history: a bin whose new-bin entry, flagged consigned with its fill-to level, is not yet there has no opening stock worked out; and a bin none of whose par level entries carries a reorder point above zero has none placed.

### Booking the line: `stock_opening_consignment_2b5b5df3`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books a single consigned-stocking line for the bin at the visit given: the units placed, the contract unit price they are carried at, and their value, units times unit price rounded half up to the cent. The program's consigned stock value rises by that value. The line is dated today.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `vmi_program_id` | the reference number of the StockSmart program that holds the bin, read from the StockSmart program lookup | identifier |
| `activity_reference` | the reference of the service visit at which the stock is placed, as shown on the visit line in the program activity history | text, copied character for character, format VV-NNNNNN |
| `bin_label` | the consigned bin's label exactly as it appears on its entry in the bin history | text, copied character for character |
| `sku` | the Corbett item number exactly as it appears on the bin's entry | text, copied character for character |
| `quantity` | the units placed in the bin | whole number, 1 or more |
| `unit_price` | the contract unit price of the item in USD, as shown on the item's contract price line | decimal, 4 places |

### Receipt

On success: `status` "recorded", `vmi_activity_id` (reference number of the stocking line), `activity_reference`, `bin_label`, `sku`, `quantity` (whole units), `unit_price` (USD, 4 decimal places), `extended_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `consigned_stock_value` (the program's consigned stock value including this booking, USD, 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The tool defines no other outcome.

### Basis questions

**When does such a bin take effect?** At the program's service visit of the day its entries stand, and the opening stock is placed at that visit. Every other bin change still takes effect from the next visit or scan.

**At what price is the opening stock carried?** At the item's contract unit price.
